description: This file defines the OA_Dll_Channel class, which extends OA_Dll and manages channel data, validation, modification, deletion, retrieval, and targeting within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Dll_Channel
classes.description: A class extending OA_Dll that manages channels, including CRUD operations, validation, and targeting management.

methods.name: _setChannelDataFromArray
methods.description: Populates an OA_Dll_ChannelInfo object with data from an array, mapping fields accordingly.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates channel data, checking required fields and existence in the database.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Adds or updates a channel record, performing permission checks and validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a channel by ID after permission and existence checks.

methods.name: getChannel
methods.description: Retrieves channel information for a given ID, populating an OA_Dll_ChannelInfo object.

methods.name: getChannelList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of channels filtered by agency or website ID.

methods.name: getChannelTargeting
methods.description: Fetches targeting limitations associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: _validateTargeting
methods.description: Validates a targeting object, including plugin availability.

methods.name: setChannelTargeting
methods.description: Sets and overrides targeting limitations for a channel, updating compiled limitations and plugins.
